summary: RFC close-out: how sign-offs owed by Design and Product are obtained

options.description: Planner drafts one sign-off request per owner; the operator sends them
The operator signs on behalf of Design and Product with a dated note
Exclude the five RFCs from this close-out until the owners act
Change the rule so a built RFC needs only Engineering and Operator sign-off

body: Problem: five RFCs wait on sign-offs only other owners can give: Design on 0018, 0028 and 0030, Product on 0055 and 0062. Ruling: the planner drafts one sign-off request packet per owner and the operator sends them; those RFCs close when the owners answer and the rest of the close-out does not wait. The sign-off rule is unchanged. The options are those put to the operator through the decision rubric on 2026-11-18; recorded by the planner.
